about: Intended placements the placement audit (npm run audit:placement) may report. Globs match item keys, owners or assets (see renderer/src/farm/dev/placementCore.ts). Every entry needs a reason; 'max' caps the metric (bigger still surfaces), 'min' requires extra metrics (e.g. base separation).
